title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB pack on vLLM (NVIDIA's recipe)
slug_note: NVIDIA's own vLLM command for the 2-bit-expert 24 GB pack, with DFlash speculative decoding.

variation.quant_detail: IQ2 experts (quantisation-aware distillation) with higher-precision other layers, 24.1 GB packed

engine.config: NVIDIA card Quick Start: vLLM nightly, b12x kernels, FP8 KV, 256K, 1 sequence, DFlash drafter (7 tokens)

requirements.notes: Estimate: the 24.1 GB pack plus the drafter and FP8 KV cache; NVIDIA lists RTX 5090, DGX Spark and RTX Spark as supported hardware. Not measured.

run.command: vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB --trust-remote-code --load-format auto --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 1 --enable-chunked-prefill --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --linear-backend b12x --moe-backend b12x --attention-backend FLASHINFER --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-cache-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-cache-mode align --seed 42 --allowed-local-media-path / --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video":1,"image":1}' --video-pruning-rate 0.5 --media-io-kwargs '{"video":{"fps":2,"num_frames":256}}' --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser-plugin ultra_v3_reasoning_parser.py --reasoning-parser ultra_v3 --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB-LiLiCorr","num_speculative_tokens":7,"rejection_sample_method":"standard","attention_backend":"FLASHINFER","draft_load_config":{"load_format":"auto"}}'

steps.text: vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB --trust-remote-code --load-format auto --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 1 --enable-chunked-prefill --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --linear-backend b12x --moe-backend b12x --attention-backend FLASHINFER --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-cache-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-cache-mode align --seed 42 --allowed-local-media-path / --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video":1,"image":1}' --video-pruning-rate 0.5 --media-io-kwargs '{"video":{"fps":2,"num_frames":256}}' --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser-plugin ultra_v3_reasoning_parser.py --reasoning-parser ultra_v3 --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB-LiLiCorr","num_speculative_tokens":7,"rejection_sample_method":"standard","attention_backend":"FLASHINFER","draft_load_config":{"load_format":"auto"}}'

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet.
Steps 2-6 run inside the container that step 1 opens.
spec_decode is 'other': NVIDIA's DFlash method with the LiLiCorr drafter, which this directory's enum does not name.
The experts are 2-bit; NVIDIA recovers accuracy with quantisation-aware distillation, but quality at this size has not been checked here.
